01

new words

vocabulary · speaking
👗 costume
special clothes for a party: a witch costume
😱 scary
it makes you afraid
🎈 decorate
make a room beautiful for a party
🗣️ scream
shout very loudly: “AAAAH!”
🏆 contest
a competition — the best person wins
💡 turn off the lights
make the room dark

What is the best Halloween costume for your brother? 👦

I think the best costume for him is ... because he’s ...

🧠 Past Simple = finished actions in the past. yesterday · last Friday · last weekend · two days ago
Last Friday we had a party. We danced. — Today’s mission: use it when you SPEAK! Mistakes are OK 💛

🔁 Remember? is → was · are → were

scary
→ scarier than
→ the scariest
big
→ bigger than
→ the biggest
creative
→ more creative
→ the most creative
good
→ better than
→ the best
bad
→ worse than
→ the worst

03

brittany’s post

reading

Brittany wrote a post about the party. Read it. Were your guesses right? 🎃

kit_brit 🤍
Highland High · Saturday
the BEST halloween party ever 🎃🖤

Hi guys!! Last Friday we had a Halloween party at school and it was AMAZING! Mandy and I decorated the gym after school. We put pumpkins, bats and spiders everywhere 🕷️ It took three hours!

I wore a witch costume — my mum made my hat 🧙‍♀️ Bobby came as a vampire. He drew the blood on his face himself and it looked so real! Jake was a robot. His costume had little lights and they changed colour 🤖 He wrote the code for them!!

Alex was a zombie, of course 🧟 He hid behind the door and screamed at people. Leo dropped all his candy 😂 We ate pizza and pumpkin cake, Leo played the guitar and we danced a lot 💃

At eight o’clock Ms Brown and Coach Miller chose the best costumes. Jake won “the most creative costume” 🏆 Alex’s costume was the scariest, and Tyler’s skeleton was the funniest — it was too small for him 😂

Then something happened at nine o’clock... but that’s Alex’s story 😉

❤️ 214💬 37👁 865

true or false?

reading

Read the post again (go back ←). Choose True or False. Then say the correct sentence when it’s false!

1  Brittany and Mandy decorated the gym.
2  Brittany made her witch hat. 🧙‍♀️
3  Jake’s costume had lights.
4  Bobby bought fake blood for his face.
5  Leo dropped his candy because Alex screamed. 😂
6  Tyler’s costume was too big for him.
03

notice the grammar

past simple

These sentences are from the post. Look at the verbs.

➕ positive

She wore a witch costume.
We danced a lot.
The party was amazing.
The costumes were scary.

➖ negative

Bobby didn’t buy a costume.
Alex didn’t win.
It wasn’t a ghost!
⚠️ didn’t + verb: didn’t won → didn’t win

❓ questions

Did you dance?
→ Yes, I did. / No, I didn’t.
What did you wear?
→ I wore a ...

⏰ yesterday · last Friday · last weekend · two days ago · at nine o’clock   🔗 first · then · after that

alex’s script

read after listening
🔒

First finish and check the listening tasks.
Then you can read what Alex said.

Now read what Alex said. Listen again and read at the same time. 🎧👀 The orange words were the answers.

Hey guys, it’s Alex. So... about the party. 🧟

OK, at nine o’clock I was really bored. The music was quieter than at the last party, and Mandy’s games were the most boring games in the world.

So I went to the hall and I turned off the lights. Everyone screamed! Leo screamed louder than the girls, haha!

Then Coach Miller found me. He wasn’t happy. He took my zombie mask and he called my dad.

Now I have to clean the gym on Saturday. With Mandy! This is the worst week of my life.

But hey... it was funny, right? 😏

Alex 🧟 · voice message
0:00 / 0:49
🐢 speed:
